source_title: CE 异步重载配方时调用 MMOItems 同步事件导致 GenerateLoreEvent 报错
raw_log:
[WARN] [CraftEngine] Failed to build item 'MATERIAL:GHOSTLY_ECOPLASM' from plugin 'mmoitems'
java.lang.IllegalStateException: GenerateLoreEvent may only be triggered synchronously.
    at io.papermc.paper.plugin.manager.PaperEventManager.callEvent(PaperEventManager.java:45)
    at ...ItemStackBuilder.buildNBT(ItemStackBuilder.java:263)  ← MMOItems fires sync-only event
    at ...ItemStackBuilder.build(ItemStackBuilder.java:308)
    at ...MMOItemsProvider.buildOrNull(MMOItemsProvider.java:54)  ← CE → MMOItems bridge
    at ...ExternalSourceProcessor.apply(ExternalSourceProcessor.java:52)
    at ...BukkitItemDefinition.buildItem(BukkitItemDefinition.java:47)
    at ...BukkitRecipeManager.getIngredientLooks(BukkitRecipeManager.java:74)  ← recipe preview build
    at ...InjectedShapedRecipe.of(InjectedShapedRecipe.java:34)
    at ...FastNMSImpl.createShapedRecipe(FastNMSImpl.java:175)
    at ...BukkitRecipeManager.delayedLoad(BukkitRecipeManager.java:191)  ← async reload
    at ...CraftEngine.lambda$runDelayTasks$9(CraftEngine.java:241)
    at java.base/java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture$AsyncRun.run(...)
    at java.base/java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool.runWorker(...)  ← off-thread!
fix_solution: 【推断】检查插件调用时机及状态，升级相关插件（依据：堆栈显示 IllegalStateException，对象状态不合法通常因调用顺序错误或插件 bug）
